title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.22355）：OmniVerifier-C1 是 'decomposed graded verifier for rule-governed generative world modeling'，把 'conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments' 推到 'automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores'。是 llm-evaluation × multimodal-agent × rag-knowledge 的 'graded verifier' 趋势资产——'分解 + 连续打分' 范式可迁移到任意 VLM judge / RAG judge / agent eval 子方向，与 OverclaimBench / general judge 路线同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7-14 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 decomposition 协议 / 跨 VLM baseline。
